data.name: quicksave
data.shortDescription: Saves to a predefined slot when you press a hotkey (configurable)
data.description:
As title says, lets you save by pressing a choosen keybind (default F5). I feel this is more an QoL update, than anything else. You already could save literally anywhere by carrying a tarp + stick, so this just ommits that minor inconvinience pretty much.

----Unecessary details-----
Quicksave save folder is 1111111111, from my testing it had to be 10 digits, and all 0's didn't work, so I just decided to spam 1's instead and it worked, that's why it's all 1's (that, and it's easy to see).
